# Vladimir Osenev

> AI engineer in Prague, CZ (remote-ready). Retrieval (RAG, embeddings, vector search), LLM evaluation and AI agents. Open to work. Speaks Russian, English and Czech. CS at Charles University.

Contact: osenevvova@gmail.com · https://github.com/osenevv · https://linkedin.com/in/vosenev

## Projects
- ZettelLinker (github.com/osenevv/zettlellinker): finds missing links in an Obsidian vault by meaning using local sentence-transformer embeddings; LangGraph pipeline; 0.38 ms median query over 10,000 vectors.
- Yapper (github.com/osenevv/Yapper): macOS app turning voice notes into tasks and long-term memory; on-device transcription; CI on Python 3.10–3.12.
- Mafia Tracker (github.com/osenevv/mafia-tracker): live tournament platform for 10-player Mafia; Django Channels WebSockets push game state to every screen; ratio-based Elo engine.
- SatFreedom (github.com/osenevv/SatFreedom): private, watch-only Bitcoin savings journal; C#/.NET with Avalonia.
- Personal Agentic Wiki: personal knowledge base maintained by LLM agents; this website is built from a slice of it.
